name: Baijiu
description: Sorghum spirit, very strong and very aromatic — drunk in small cups at table.

tcm.note: A strong spirit; hot and dispersing.

ayurveda.note: Madya is ushna in a high degree.

histamine.note: Distilled, so lower in histamine than wine or beer — but alcohol blocks DAO regardless.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. A small cup goes further than the same size of Western spirits — baijiu runs some of the strongest ABV on the shelf. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
